about: Phone numbers read digit by digit in their groups, 0 as 'oh', a comma pause between groups (loop B168, BI-148). North American numbers with matching separators (or parentheses, or spaces after +1), toll-free 8x00 as 'eight hundred', vanity 1-800-LETTERS, seven-digit numbers only after a phone word, N11 codes (911, 411, 311) after call/dial/text or before call/operator, and 9-1-1. Negatives (ranges, years, scores, I-405, amounts, times, an area code starting 1, bare spaced digits, 'Porsche 911') keep Backseat's ordinary reading. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / PhoneNumbers (libs/backseat/pronunciation_phones.hpp). Shared with BookLyre (CROSS).
